info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Drivers-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Driver Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about drivers associated with rideshare services. This API is intended for applications that need to display driver profiles, their availability, and ride history. Typically, transportation platforms or mobile apps leveraging this API can enhance their user experience by providing real-time driver insights. It is designed to improve rider experience and operational efficiency in rideshare applications.

get.summary: Retrieve ride details for a specific driver.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the rides associated with a particular driver. It includes filters for ride status and timing to help drivers manage their assignments effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving driver ride information. It should contain the necessary parameters to fetch the rides assigned to a particular driver.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning driver ride information.
